_doc.about: Copy this file to <data dir>/brand.json (the data dir is CAROUSEL_HOME, or .carousel in the folder you run from) and edit it. Every key is optional: anything left out keeps the neutral default shown here. Keys starting with an underscore are notes and are ignored.
_doc.name: Your name or business name. Used as the name on the Quote template (04) and by caption drafting.
_doc.handle: Your social handle, without a platform. Used by caption drafting, never printed on a slide by default.
_doc.byline: One line shown beside the logo when the byline is switched on, and on the call to action slide (10). Markup: **bold** and *accent*. Example: **Riverbend Bakery** · Fresh every morning. Leave empty to show no byline.

colors.bgDeep: Second background tone, used at the bottom of the gradient and behind cards.
colors.bgAlt: Third background tone, used for lit panels and the call to action slide.
colors.text: Main text colour. It needs strong contrast with bg.
colors.accent: The brand colour: the big number, the step numeral, the keyword pill, the lit bar and the lit cell.
colors.accentSoft: A lighter tint of the accent: the italic accent word (*word*) in headlines.
colors.highlight: A second highlight, used for bold words (**word**) in headlines.

fonts.display: Headline font. family is the font name; file is a path to a .woff2, .woff, .ttf or .otf file (relative to this file), or null to use a bundled or installed font. Bundled: Cormorant Garamond.
fonts.body: Body and label font. Same shape as display. Bundled: Plus Jakarta Sans.

_doc.logo: Path (relative to this file) or https URL of a square logo, SVG or PNG. null shows no logo. Example: ../assets/placeholder-logo.svg
_doc.portrait: Path or https URL of a portrait photo, used by layouts 02, 04 and 10 when a slide gives no photo. null means those layouts render without a photo. Example: ../assets/placeholder-portrait.svg

chrome.showByline: true puts the logo and byline at the top of every slide.
chrome.showCounter: true puts a slide counter (03 / 08) at the top right.
chrome.showProgress: true puts a progress bar at the bottom.
chrome.showCue: true puts a Swipe cue at the bottom (Save this on the last slide).
chrome.showCorners: true draws two thin corner marks in the accent colour on every slide.

_doc.voiceProfilePath: Path to a text or markdown file describing how you write. Caption drafting reads it when present. null to skip.
_doc.defaultHashtags: List of hashtags added to drafted captions, for example ["#bakery", "#sourdough"].
